description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle data source and database-specific persistence behavior to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including SQL and photo binary storage.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL driver and configure the application datasource and Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert Oracle-specific SQL and schema definitions to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea. Replace plaintext datasource credentials with Managed Identity authentication and apply the configuration consistently to application and Docker profiles.
